description: This file is an implementation of the COBBusinessStepService interface, specifically the class COBBusinessStepServiceImpl. It manages execution logic for a series of business steps in a Continuity of Business (COB) process, including running steps and retrieving configured steps based on a job name. It interacts with repositories, application context, and services related to business step execution, event notification, and configuration within the project.

classes.name: COBBusinessStepServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the COBBusinessStepService that orchestrates execution and retrieval of COB business steps, managing event recording and interactions with relevant repositories and services.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a series of business steps based on the provided execution map, handling event recording and context management.

methods.name: getCOBBusinessSteps
methods.description: Retrieves and maps configured COB business steps for a specific job name, returning their names and order.
